> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.2.0 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

People Atlas 0.2.0 adds a curated person editor for names, aliases, organisations, photos, and validated contact links while preserving unrelated frontmatter. Name changes can propose a safe same-folder file rename that requires separate confirmation.

This release also adds configurable relationship presets and optional endpoint roles. Presets copy their types, direction, and roles into relationship notes, keeping the Markdown durable and reviewable even when settings later change.
